errors.text_span: които са маркирани с линейна скала от 11 000 до 15 000 хил. лв. с интервали от 500 хил. лв.
errors.evidence: The description inaccurately states that the y-axis is marked with values like "11 000 хил. лв." and intervals of "500 хил. лв.". The axis is marked with the numbers 11000, 11500, etc., and the unit "Хиляди лева" (хил. лв.) is a separate label for the entire axis. The description conflates the tick mark labels with the unit.
